description: Budget never enforced. estimated_tokens computed after full build, never used to gate inclusion.
current_behavior: _estimate_tokens() called after packet is fully built, result placed in receipt but never used for selection.
recommended_action: Implement incremental token tracking during candidate discovery. Select candidates until budget exhausted. Record omissions.

description: CompressionMode enum exists and symbol_codec.py is implemented, but compiler never applies compression to output.
current_behavior: execute() builds full packet without compression. packet.substitution_table_sha256 always None.
recommended_action: Apply SymbolCodec when CompressionMode != NONE. Check net savings before applying.

description: DetailLevel (summary/standard/deep) defined but never read. Always builds full detail.
current_behavior: All subsystems, all files, full paths returned regardless of detail level.
recommended_action: Summary: only subsystem names + entry points. Standard: config/docs. Deep: all paths including schemas/tests.

description: scope.paths passed to build_active_work() for collision detection but never used for targeted file selection or relation expansion.
current_behavior: execute() passes scope.paths to build_active_work() only. No targeted context for requested paths.
recommended_action: Use scope.paths as seed for candidate discovery. Expand via RepoContextIndex for related tests/docs/schemas.

description: user_text parameter accepted but never analyzed. No task-specific relevance scoring.
current_behavior: build_envelope() docstring says user_text is used but function body ignores it.
recommended_action: Implement token-based relevance scoring: match user_text terms against file paths, symbols, subsystem names.

description: Recommendations are deterministic but not relevance-aware. Always picks first config/doc per subsystem.
current_behavior: Top 5 subsystems, first config file, first doc file. No task or budget consideration.
recommended_action: Score candidates by relevance (task match, recency, risk) before recommending.

description: No incremental token budget tracking. Full packet built, then estimated.
current_behavior: _estimate_tokens() runs on completed packet. No gating during construction.
recommended_action: Track cumulative estimated tokens during candidate discovery. Stop adding when budget exceeded. Record omissions with reason.

description: SymbolCodec exists with compress/decompress/estimate_tokens. Never called from compiler.
current_behavior: SymbolCodec is tested but orphaned — no production caller.
recommended_action: Call SymbolCodec.compress() on rendered output when CompressionMode != NONE. Check net savings positive before applying. Store substitution table SHA.

description: Recent messages section includes first 120 chars of user/assistant content in system prompt.
current_behavior: Messages with non-system role appended with truncated content.
recommended_action: Replace raw content with content_sha256 + role + byte_count. Or gate behind include_message_summaries flag.

description: Receipt paths include full relative path in packet output.
recommended_action: Use path_hash + path_kind instead of raw path. Keep kind/suffix for filtering.

description: generated_at uses datetime.now(UTC), making packet hash non-deterministic across identical inputs.
current_behavior: Every call produces different generated_at, hence different canonical_packet_sha256.
recommended_action: Exclude generated_at from canonical hash computation. Use input-derived fingerprint for cache key.
Use deterministic hash-based ID derived from request + repo state for cache dedup.

description: Bare except Exception: pass wraps entire build_envelope body. All structural failures silent.
current_behavior: Envelope returned empty on any exception. No warning, no diagnostic.
recommended_action: Log structured warnings per failure. Return envelope with warnings field. Never let assembly errors silently produce empty context.

description: All sections concatenated monolithically. No cache tier separation.
current_behavior: Sections joined with double newline. No ordering for prefix caching.
recommended_action: Arrange sections: stable (repo topology, AGENTS.md, schemas) first, dynamic (dirty files, active lanes, receipts) last. Add cache tier hints.

description: symbol_map field always empty. Schema promises aliases/symbols but compiler never populates.
recommended_action: Populate from SymbolCodec when compression applied. Otherwise document as future feature.

description: RepoContextIndex exists with relation queries (test/doc/schema/same-package) but compiler never constructs or calls it.
current_behavior: execute() does not import or instantiate RepoContextIndex.
recommended_action: Construct RepoContextIndex during execute(). Use for relation expansion when scope.paths provided.
